initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 3024. The corresponding git-svn commit ef3b686fb9da9620a906b12850978179ab3de6f9, titled 'task 3521: fix slashes in atom feeds', changed the old Publisher.java v3 atom-feed path generation from File.separator to a literal URL '/'.
additional_context: Current source searches found no v3-codesystems.xml reference and no XML/HTML link href values containing backslashes. The active current downloads page is source/downloads.html, listed by publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml, and it now links to definitions and NPM packages rather than the legacy v3-codesystems.xml feed. Jira searches found only FHIR-3521 for this wording, while Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion or later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is appropriate because the historical request was applied and the affected legacy generated artifact is not part of the current build surface.
